entries.text:
Oh! Well, if isn’t my pal [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
I’d actually love to grab your ear for something,
but...just look at how many Pokémon you’ve got!\c
Think you could make some space in your Boxes
or your team, then come talk to me again?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_00

entries.text: Hehe... I came to check on how you’re doing!\nI AM your homeroom teacher, after all.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_02

entries.text: Once I got here, I decided to do a bit of\nresearch on the Pokémon of Kitakami, and—[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_03

entries.text: I got so engrossed in my own research that I\nactually forgot to come find you, didn’t I![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_05

entries.text: Well, how about I make up for it by treating you\nto a picnic?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_06

entries.text: I thought something like this might happen,\nso I borrowed all the usual picnic things from\r\nDirector Clavell.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_07

entries.text: Dig in! I hope you like the sandwich I made![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_08

entries.text: It may, um, look a bit strange—but I can assure\nyou it tastes great![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_09

entries.text: I don’t get out much, so this kind of fieldwork\nsure wears me out quick...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_10

entries.text: I can’t believe how you kids run all over the place\nfor your Treasure Hunt! You’re really something![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_11

entries.text: Oh...? Could there be something in my basket?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_12

entries.text: A Pokémon Egg appeared in the basket![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_14

entries.text: Quite the mystery, isn’t it? I only brought Gulpin\nto this picnic with me, and yet...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_15

entries.text: How could it have appeared, then?
entries.label: s1_sub_001_select_03

entries.text: Did you put the Egg in the basket?
entries.label: s1_sub_001_select_04

entries.text: Hehe... OK, I confess! Truth is, I had this Egg\nwith me the whole time.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_16

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hehe... I can’t get anything past you, can I,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_17

entries.text: You know about the Pokémon Eggs you can find\nduring picnics, right?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_18

entries.text: Whenever a Trainer doesn’t have the means to\ncare for an Egg they find, they can have it sent to\r\nthe academy, where we’ll take care of it.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_19

entries.text: But then I thought, “Say, wouldn’t it be better to\nhave a great Trainer raise the Pokémon instead?”\r\nSo I brought this Egg with me![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_20

entries.text: You were entrusted with the Pokémon Egg!
entries.label: s1_sub_001_system_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hehe... I know it’s odd of me to come all the way
to Kitakami just to hand over a Pokémon Egg.\c
But I knew it would be safe with you,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_22

entries.text: That reminds me—are you still using your\nPokédex app over here too?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_23

entries.text: You should be able to fill the Kitakami Pokédex\nby catching Pokémon that live around here.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_24

entries.text: I’ll be doing fieldwork in the area for a while...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_25

entries.text: so let me know if you manage to complete the\nKitakami Pokédex in your app![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_001_ecology_26
